newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger warns against tactical voting.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger warns against tactical voting.

text.p: On the eve of the general election New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger again cautioned his supporters on Friday against tactical voting, saying that if people want a National-led government, they should vote National.
"There's this story running round out there, 'vote for Act and you'll help the National Party'.
"If you want a National-led government, vote for the National Party."
Bolger made the comments as he and Labour Leader Helen Clark went head-to-head for the last time before the election, in a debate on Radio Pacific.
